title: A sorted list with a seam
hook: The array is sorted, except where its ends were joined.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Choose the sorted half of a rotated distinct-key array before deciding whether it can contain the target.

misconception: A rotation destroys every useful ordering fact.
objective: Choose the sorted half of a rotated distinct-key array before deciding whether it can contain the target.

claims.text: One side of each middle is sorted. Its endpoint tests decide whether it can contain the target; rotation does not justify applying an ordinary sorted-array test to the whole interval.
